in_arabic.name: رفيدة
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مؤنث يعني الرفد والمساعدة والنصرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم رفيدة مشتق من الفعل رَفَدَ، ويعني الرفد والمساعدة والنصرة. يدل على معنى الإعانة والمدد، وقد ورد في بعض الأحاديث النبوية الشريفة. في اللغة العربية، يُستخدم الاسم للدلالة على الشخص الذي يقدم العون والمساندة للآخرين.

in_urdu.name: رفیدہ
in_urdu.meaning: مساعدة، حمایت، اور سہارا دینے والی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رفیدہ نام عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مساعدة، حمایت، اور سہارا دینے والی۔ یہ نام اسلامی ثقافت میں اہمیت رکھتا ہے، خاص طور پر حضرت رفیدہ رضی اللہ عنہا، جو ایک معروف صحابیہ تھیں اور انصاری خاندان سے تھیں۔

in_hindi.name: रफ़ीदा
in_hindi.meaning: सहायता करने वाली, मदद करने वाली
in_hindi.long_meaning: रफ़ीदा नाम का अर्थ है सहायता करने वाली या मदद करने वाली। यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है और इसका उपयोग उन लड़कियों के लिए किया जाता है जो दूसरों की मदद करने की प्रवृत्ति रखती हैं। इस्लामी परंपरा में, रफ़ीदा नाम की एक प्रसिद्ध सहाबी भी थीं जिन्होंने महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाई थी।

in_pashto.name: رفيدة
in_pashto.long_meaning: رفيدة نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی يې په مرستا، ملاتړ، او لاسپوځی کې ده. دا نوم د افغان او پښتني ټولنو کې د کارونې وړ دی، ځکه چې دا د یوې مرستندې او ملاتړونکې نجلۍ په معنا کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Rufaida
in_english.meaning: one who provides assistance, support, and help
in_english.long_meaning: The name Rufaida originates from the Arabic root 'R-F-D', meaning to provide assistance, support, or help. It is a significant name in Islamic tradition, associated with a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, Rufaida bint Abi Rufaida. The name symbolizes kindness, generosity, and a supportive nature. In various Muslim cultures, Rufaida is used to signify a person who offers aid and comfort to others.

data.cultural_impact: The name Rufaida carries a deep symbolism in Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures. Derived from Arabic roots, the name Rufaida is considered to be as rich as the cultural and historical context in which it emerged. In Arabic, "rufaida" means comfort or support, and in Islamic and Middle Eastern cultures, such meanings are deeply intertwined with acts of kindness and compassion towards the needy and the poor. In Islamic societies, the name Rufaida is often given to girls who are expected to embody the virtues of compassion, kindness, and selflessness. These values are highly valued in Islamic traditions and are a central part of the Islamic belief system.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Rufaida holds significant meaning as well. In Islam, it is believed that kindness and compassion towards others, particularly towards the needy and the poor, brings one closer to Allah (God). The Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) is reported to have said, "Whoever relieves a believer's distress, Allah will relieve his distress on the Day of Judgment." (Bukhari and Muslim) Thus, the name Rufaida can be seen as a reminder of the spiritual importance of compassion and kindness towards others. Furthermore, the name Rufaida can be seen as a reflection of the Prophet Muhammad's (PBUH) own compassionate nature, as he is known to have shown great compassion and kindness towards all people, regardless of their social or economic status. Overall, the name Rufaida represents not only a cultural and historical tradition of compassion in Islamic and Middle Eastern societies, but also a deeply spiritual significance, reminding us of the importance of being kind and compassionate towards others, and bringing us closer to Allah.
